profile.headline: Full Stack Developer/Technologist at Wabtec Corporation
profile.summary: Experienced Staff Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in HTML, Web Applications, Agile Methodologies, Software Development, and JavaScript. Strong engineering professional with a BBA focused in Operations Research and Information Systems from Eastern Michigan University.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead Front-end Developer on Foresee application for Global Research Center (GRC)
Environment: HTML5, Javascript, CSS, Sass, AngularJS, UX design, Polymer, Predix UI Components
- Lead Front-end Developer on OpsVision machine visualization tool for GE Transportation
Environment: HTML5, Javascript, NodeJS, Polymer, Predix UI Components, CI/CD, Jenkins

positions.title: Software Engineer - Proficy MES UI Design
positions.description:
- Lead Full Stack Developer on Inventory process application
Environment: .NET, Oracle DB, SqlDeveloper, Jenkins
- Front-end Developer on Engine Tracker application
Environment: ThingWorx

positions.title: Front-end Web Developer
positions.description:
Lead Front-End Developer supporting Treasury on Ratings Model Application and Trade Request System. Instrumental in the development of shared components for Treasury Design Extension (TDx). The Front-End code is developed using JavaScript, HTML5, JQuery, Backbone, Marionette, Bootstrap and Agile Project Management.
Developed new AMSTC public web page from specifications created by UX designers using HTML5, CSS and Bootstrap.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: TIBCO/Java Developer on Treasury Vault Application developed with JSP, Java, TIBCO ESB and TIBCO Business Works. Lead Developer on in:treasury portal utilizing TIBCO Portal Builder, HTML and JavaScript.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Technical Lead on a major consumer web application project for General Motors (GM), which will change the way people buy cars.  My responsibilities include planning, design and development, implementation of application code, and integration & coordination of third party web services.  The application is developed using JSP, Java, JavaScript, JQuery, MySQL, AJAX, XML and GlassFish.

positions.title: Contract Developer
positions.description: Spearheaded the development of web services for the critical emergency response support system for the Space and Naval Warfare System Command (SPAWAR).  Operating globally, the system provides 24x7 support with proactive telephone alerts and direct dial response for current status of personnel.  The system was developed as a web application utilizing web services using Oracle 10g, JDeveloper, Java EJB 3.0, JMS, Struts, JSF and ADF.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for the design, development and deployment of Team Detroit’s Client Account Management application, Purchase Order Approval application, Vendor Payment application, Procurement Approval application and Data Warehouse application.  Duties include requirements gathering, hands-on development of all applications with the End-User and application troubleshooting/problem resolution. Utilizing J2EE web development focusing on both front and back end coding using Java, JavaScript, HTML, AJAX, DWR, XML, XSLT, DOM, JUnit, EXTJS, Oracle, SQL, Web2.0, CSS, Swing, XPATH, Hibernate, Apache/Tomcat, Eclipse, CVS, CruiseControl, Agile, Continuous Integration (CI) and Test Driven Development (TDD).

positions.title: Contract Application Developer
positions.description:
May 2002 to March 2003 – As a member of the project team my responsibilities were to convert Lotus Domino web based applications to J2EE web applications.  The applications were developed using Java, JavaScript, HTML, DHTML, CSS, XML, XML Server Page Technology (XSP) and SQL Server.

March 2001 to May 2002 – Developed and implemented Domino web applications.  The applications were designed and developed on the Lotus Domino platform utilizing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Jacada, Flowbuilder and PDF infusion.

positions.title: Collaborative Solutions Technologist
positions.description: Collaborative Solutions Technologist focusing on eCRM development using Lotus Domino, IBM WebSphere, VisualAge for Java and Oracle.  While at Click2Community, I researched potential environment configurations for the development of the eCRM product.  In addition, I implement an internal Lotus QuickPlace site for company collaboration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer using Lotus Notes/Domino to develop intranet and extranet application.  At Fry, I was a member of the Domino’s Pizza project team, where I wrote technical specifications, developed and implemented applications for the Domino’s Pizza extranet site.  Additionally, I supported the Fry Multimedia intranet site using Lotus Domino.

positions.title: Application Development Consultant
positions.description: Principal-Certified Lotus Professional consulting on application development using Lotus Notes/Domino.  Developed Collaboration and Knowledge Management applications using Lotus Notes/Domino.  Additionally, I developed applications for our internal team to present at LotusSphere 1998 & 1999 and I developed application for Domino Instant Host and researched Domino QuickPlace.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
June 1997 to December 1997 – Responsibilities included development, implementation, maintenance and support of Lotus Notes applications.

March 1996 to June 1997 – Supported the international department on a client server environment. Responsibilities included development, implementation, maintenance and support of Letters of Credit, Collections and Foreign Exchange systems and interfaces.  The system required the knowledge of OS/2, REXX, Micro Focus COBOL, Windows, Powerbuilder and Lotus Notes.

June 1994 to March 1996 – Responsibilities included development, implementation, maintenance and support for John V. Carr & Son, Inc.  The Customs House Brokerage system required knowledge of IBM AS/400, Powerhouse 4GL and COBOL 400.

positions.title: Contract Programmer
positions.description: Contract Programmer at John V. Carr & Son, Inc., a Customs House Brokerage company.  At this position I developed, installed and maintained import and export systems using COBOL and 4GL tools on Unisys V380 and V530.  The Unisys system was converted to an IBM AS/400 platform where my responsibilities continued utilizing Powerhouse 4GL software and COBOL 400.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Programmer Analyst for a book and journal manufacturing company.  My responsibilities included; systems development, implementation, maintenance and data communications networking.  At this position I used, CANDE, COBOL 68 & 74, NDL, GEMCOS, BNA, COMS, DMSII and the fourth generation software GENPULSE, IMPULSE and DATAPULSE.  The hardware used was a Burroughs B2930 and B874 front end processor, a Unisys A-6 and CP2000 front end processor and Convergent Technologies micro systems.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Programmer providing information systems for hospitals and outpatient medical clinics utilizing COBOL, CANDE editor, GEMCOS, and DMSII on Burroughs 1990 and 1955 computers.
